note: List name pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9._ \-]+$/i ends with a literal /i after an end anchor; no string can satisfy it. The same provider pages specify alphanumeric names and give Email subscription-list and Subscibers List as valid examples. The node implements that documented character set and length, without the erroneous delimiter/flag suffix.
